rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP and viewed relevant orders, then executed an exchange using the tools. However, the policy requires explicit confirmation before any order-changing write; the agent submitted the exchange without asking the user to confirm. Additionally, the agent stated a specific refund amount, payment card details, and a color change to black without visible tool-backed justification or prior user confirmation. These issues violate the confirmation and correctness requirements, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
